reviews.title: DDR 5 32Gb memory
reviews.comment: The memory arrived on time well packaged and worked fine on installation and has not cause any problems 4 months use.  It is well built with heat sink installed and ready for installation.  I would recommend.
reviews.author: Harold N Oedbauer

reviews.title: Rock Solid, Just Works
reviews.comment: Plug and go DDR5 32GB bad boys.... Be patient while BIOS detects and sets... Runs flawlessly, fast, cool, priced right. In an ASUS B760i mini-ITX, i5 fresh build....
reviews.author: Tattoo Jim

reviews.title: Great memory sticks
reviews.comment: Been overclocking this memory for about a month now with no lag. Keeps up with constant afk grinding games no problem.
reviews.author: Troy

reviews.title: Easy to install
reviews.comment: Bought 2x16 RAM 5600.  Just make sure to put it in slots 2 and 4 if you are only using 2 RAM sticks.  Make sure you double check the proper placement for your specific motherboard.  Would recommend.
reviews.author: Aus10
